notes: Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (customer-facing dashboards + in-product assistance). Previously trialed Hosted API for chat + embeddings — fast onboarding, predictable dev experience.
Why Dedicated now: steady production traffic, cost predictability required for product tiering, and VPC requirement for private peering.
Primary ask from CTO: Dedicated POC that demonstrates 10-20% unit cost reduction vs hosted at target latency and no quality regression on our eval set.
Traffic profile: baseline 800 QPS embedding lookups during business hours, chat peak 1200 concurrent sessions, occasional batch reranking jobs overnight.
Latency/throughput targets: 95th <= 250ms for chat token generation (short prompts), sustained throughput for embeddings 500 reqs/s, burstable to 3-5k tokens/s for short windows.

Model preferences: open-model first (quantized 13B variants), fallback to higher-quality 70B hosted variant only if quality_tolerance exceeded; interested in automatic model-variant routing and quantization guidance from Redwood Optimize.
Security/compliance notes: require SSO (SAML), full audit logs export, KMS integration for key material, and EU data residency for EU customers (will require routing policies).

POC scope (agreed): 2-week Dedicated proof-of-concept: provision dedicated pool in NA region, run canary at 5% -> 25% -> 50% over day-7, evaluate latency/cost/quality metrics, test region failover to eu-west as simulated chaos test.

Canary + fallback plan (high level): start 5% traffic to Dedicated canary (quantized 13B variant) with shadowing to hosted high-quality model; monitor latency, token-cost, hallucination rate on eval prompts; if any SLO breaches or quality regression > 2% then automatic rollback to hosted API fallback in same region; region failover plan: on NA region degradation, route to eu-west Dedicated pool if healthy, otherwise fallback to hosted multi-region endpoint.
Success criteria for POC: >=10% cost/unit improvement at target latency, no more than 1% regression on eval prompts, 99.9% availability during test window, successful KMS key rotation test.
Operational asks: CI of tracing (open-telemetry), sample streaming traces, token-level cost breakdown in Redwood Console, per-route dashboards for the canary traffic slice.
Commercial: asked for pricing scenarios (monthly reserved vs burst credits). AE shared preliminary Dedicated pricing deck; need formal legal/AML questionnaire completed before procurement.
Stakeholder notes: CTO (Priya Raman) is decision owner; Head of Prod (Evan Brooks) cares about latency and rollout controls; Platform Eng (Jasdeep Kaur) will own peering and infra work.
Quotes from call: 'We need a safe canary strategy — if quality slips we must auto-failback to hosted without customer-visible errors.'
